blocks.text: On March 11, 2026, we completed our acquisition of Wiz for $29.5 billion, after purchase price adjustments and excluding post combination compensation arrangements. This acquisition represents an investment by Google Cloud to accelerate our capabilities in multicloud and artificial intelligence (AI)-driven security. Following the close of the acquisition, the financial results are included in our consolidated financial statements within the Google Cloud segment.
